content: To make models more expressive, a bidirectional CAS-LSTM network may also be used. In the bidirectional case, the forward representations INLINEFORM0 and the backward representations INLINEFORM1 are concatenated and max-pooled to yield the sentence representation INLINEFORM2 . We call this bidirectional architecture Bi-CAS-LSTM in experiments.
